scope.PushT: E2 executed negative gate; E3/E4/E5 conditional branches not activated
scope.Walker: S2 completed and audited; S3 completed health-only and audited; S4 running at root task observation, final outcome unaudited.
final_deliverables: terminal requirement audit and delivery index

status_definitions.proven_with_scope: Specific saved executed evidence and prior audit support the stated claim only; later checks may remain.
status_definitions.valid_negative_stop: Required experiment executed and failed its scientific qualification; reporting the negative result completes that conditional branch.
status_definitions.conditional_not_activated: Downstream work must not run because its unchanged scientific prerequisite failed.
status_definitions.pending_execution_or_final_audit: Required terminal execution, audit or publication remains outstanding.
status_definitions.implemented_not_executed: Callable implementation/review exists; no current executed research artifact asserted.
status_definitions.provenance_limited: Some saved evidence exists but historical details or planned timing cannot be established retrospectively.
status_definitions.historical_diagnostic_only: Preserved older evidence cannot satisfy current qualified-stage requirements.
status_definitions.excluded_by_user: Explicitly removed from this continuation scope.

requirements.requirement: Finish through Walker S4, retain scientific stops, exclude S5 and alternative tasks.
requirements.evidence_scope: Current user-directed scope overrides the earlier S5 stretch schedule. Push-T failure does not cancel the parallel Walker track.
requirements.remaining_acceptance_check: Verify final workflow contains no S5 execution; explain any legitimate upstream stop rather than claiming all experiments ran.

requirements.requirement: Record setup, pinned upstream assets, package/rendering stack, CPU quota, thread controls and scratch-storage policy.

A later saved observation records the recovered RTX 5090/driver 595.84/compute capability 12.0/Python 3.11.16; it does not independently reconstruct pre-restart hardware.
requirements.remaining_acceptance_check: Include environment/versions and exact executed-source identity in final archive; do not equate GPU utilization with arithmetic efficiency.

requirements.evidence_scope: Evidence applies to the individual audited payload revisions, not all result/media files. Metadata-only LFS/Git hash comparison is distinct from downloading bytes. Final S2 (22 non-receipt files) and S3 (nine files) now have passed pinned private metadata/tag audits.
requirements.remaining_acceptance_check: Audit terminal S4 bank and, on a full branch, all 12 model payloads. Final reports, supplemental figures, media and source/audit archives need their own verified coverage; preserve upload exclusions and receipt/report ordering.

requirements.requirement: Checkpoint during long runs and check retained-version storage, not only latest pathname size.

The final private revision/tag passed metadata verification and its CPU export audit passed. Individual earlier audits prove only their named steps; storage estimates remain observation-time snapshots.
requirements.remaining_acceptance_check: Retain named intermediate audits and the full 172,000 recovery proof; do not infer independent verification of unsampled versions. No further S2 checkpoint is pending.

requirements.requirement: Preserve earlier files, scientific outcomes and incomplete attempts; new names and output paths only.
